content: Evidence and coverage discipline: right after every read, upsert any value that bears on the question, citing that span, before taking another action. Keep a list of the doc_id offset ranges you have already read. If the needed item is still missing, read an unread range of the same document (its start, its end, or a gap). Do not repeat a search you already ran. Once the figure is upserted, compute if needed and then finalize.
